name: Pumpkit
description: Reviews Pumpkit hosted MCP tools that publish on the user's X account, queue or change a post that publishes later without another prompt, or delete a Scheduled post. Drafting, revising and read tools keep Guard's usual handling. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Guard's Review shows the tool call's arguments, not the post that will publish: a version_id, or an edit that leaves out parts or publish_at, doesn't show the effective text or time.
Before post_now or schedule_post with a version_id, call get_post and show the person that Version's Final, every Part in order, and the publish time.
Before edit_scheduled_post or delete_scheduled_post, call list_scheduled_posts and show the person the Scheduled post's current text and time, and what the edit changes.
Keep post_now, schedule_post, edit_scheduled_post and delete_scheduled_post on Review: a Scheduled post publishes at its time with no further prompt, and post_now can't be undone.
Drafting with start_post and give_feedback only writes Versions inside Pumpkit and publishes nothing on X.
